entities.summary: Charkhari State was one of the Princely states of India during the period of the British Raj. On India's independence, this Princely state acceded to India. Currently Charkhari town, the former state's capital, is a part of Uttar Pradesh state. Charkhari State is a historical country in South Asia, established around 1765. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
